name: What should I consider when choosing finishes for a new home addition?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing finishes for a new home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting finishes, consider how the new space will function, its aesthetic integration with your existing home, and your long-term maintenance preferences. Key considerations include durability for high-traffic areas, light reflection for natural brightness, and overall color harmony. A practical tradeoff to consider is between initial cost and long-term durability or maintenance. For example, while some flooring options may have a lower upfront cost, they might require more frequent replacement or specialized care over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider function, aesthetic integration, and maintenance when choosing finishes. Balance initial cost with long-term durability and care.
